name: Docker Build, Test, and Push (Reusable)

on:
  workflow_call:
    inputs:
      docker-image-name:
        required: true
        type: string
      docker-build-dir:
        required: false
        type: string
        default: .
      docker-registry:
        required: false
        type: string
        default: docker.io
      push:
        required: false
        type: boolean
        default: false
    outputs:
      docker-image:
        description: "Fully qualified image name with tag"
        value: ${{ jobs.build-test-push.outputs.docker-image }}

jobs:
  build-test-push:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    outputs:
      docker-image: ${{ steps.set-image.outputs.docker-image }}
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up QEMU
        uses: docker/setup-qemu-action@v3

      - name: Set up Docker Buildx
        uses: docker/setup-buildx-action@v3

      - name: Login to Docker Hub
        if: ${{ inputs.push }}
        uses: docker/login-action@v3
        with:
          username: ${{ secrets.DOCKERHUB_USERNAME }}
          password: ${{ secrets.DOCKERHUB_TOKEN }}

      - name: Build and test Docker image (test stage)
        uses: docker/build-push-action@v6
        with:
          context: ${{ inputs.docker-build-dir }}
          file: ${{ inputs.docker-build-dir }}/Dockerfile
          target: test
          load: true
          tags: "${{ inputs.docker-registry }}/${{ inputs.docker-image-name }}:test"
          push: false

      - name: Compute image tags
        id: tags
        run: |
          TAG_FULL=${{ github.ref_name }}
          TAG_FULL=${TAG_FULL#v}
          TAG_MAJOR_MINOR=$(echo "$TAG_FULL" | cut -d. -f1,2)
          TAG_MAJOR=$(echo "$TAG_FULL" | cut -d. -f1)
          TAG_SHA=${{ github.sha }}
          echo "TAG_FULL=$TAG_FULL" >> $GITHUB_ENV
          echo "TAG_MAJOR_MINOR=$TAG_MAJOR_MINOR" >> $GITHUB_ENV
          echo "TAG_MAJOR=$TAG_MAJOR" >> $GITHUB_ENV
          echo "TAG_SHA=$TAG_SHA" >> $GITHUB_ENV

      - name: Build final Docker image
        uses: docker/build-push-action@v6
        with:
          context: ${{ inputs.docker-build-dir }}
          file: ${{ inputs.docker-build-dir }}/Dockerfile
          target: production
          push: ${{ inputs.push }}
          tags: |
            "${{ inputs.docker-registry }}/${{ inputs.docker-image-name }}:${{ env.TAG_FULL }}"
            "${{ inputs.docker-registry }}/${{ inputs.docker-image-name }}:${{ env.TAG_MAJOR_MINOR }}"
            "${{ inputs.docker-registry }}/${{ inputs.docker-image-name }}:${{ env.TAG_MAJOR }}"
            "${{ inputs.docker-registry }}/${{ inputs.docker-image-name }}:${{ env.TAG_SHA }}"
          load: ${{ inputs.push == false }}

      - name: Set output image
        id: set-image
        run: |
          printf 'docker-image=%s/%s:%s\n' "${{ inputs.docker-registry }}" "${{ inputs.docker-image-name }}" "${{ env.TAG_FULL }}" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
